text:
I'm using Pimsleur Hebrew - its great. You just listen and repeat, so it doesn't feel like work. I listen when I walk the dogs. I'm doing 1-2 lessons a day.
The structure is very good, learning useful things, and there's enough repetition so that you go over things enough.

For reading, I got two books from l2press.com which look very good; Hebrew sentences with English word for word translated underneath, and sentence level translation at the side. I'll also buy the audio. But I haven't started with these yet. In the meantime I'm forcing myself not to be lazy and try to read all the Hebrew I come across.
